baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive يُؤْفَكُ is joined to آيات and the habitual denial in كَانُوا ... يَجْحَدُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A visible sign supplies orientation, while knowing denial refuses the direction already recognized. The passive turning names a reversal away from the sign's proper face, and كَانُوا makes that refusal a sustained practice rather than a single mistake.

activation_trace.role: Turning something from its proper face supplies the directional reversal enacted by the passive verb.
A visible marker supplies the orientation that can be recognized and followed.
Denial despite knowledge makes the reversal a contradiction of recognized truth rather than simple ignorance.
Occurrence through time makes denial a sustained past practice feeding the present analogy.

changed_reading.before: They are merely mistaken about God's proofs.
changed_reading.after: Those who repeatedly negate recognized waymarks undergo a passive reorientation away from the face those marks indicate.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The falsehood branch of ء ف ك converges with ج ح د as outward denial of what is inwardly known.
baseline_models.mechanism: Knowing refusal turns a truthful account into its contrary. The same root that describes truth diverted into falsehood then describes the deniers themselves as diverted, allowing an action-and-recoil reading inside the focus ayah.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood as speech diverted from truth supplies the deniers' inverted account.
Knowledge retained inwardly makes the outward contrary an active inversion.
Repeated temporal occurrence lets the inversion become an established mode.

changed_reading.before: They deny and are then independently turned aside.
changed_reading.after: Their repeated conversion of recognized truth into its contrary becomes the very pattern in which they are themselves turned.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The rain-deprived land branch of ء ف ك and the scarcity branch of ج ح د coexist with آيات as visible marks.
baseline_models.mechanism: Two focus roots independently open onto failed fertility: rain is diverted from land, and good, rain, or growth becomes scarce. This permits a material model in which denial is a failure of reception, leaving a sign-bearing field unwatered and unfruitful.

activation_trace.role: Land deprived because rain is diverted supplies the receiving surface made barren.
Scarcity of good, rain, and growth supplies the resulting constriction and infertility.
Visible marks are the material that should have made the receiving field legible and responsive.

changed_reading.before: Denial is only the rejection of propositions.
changed_reading.after: Denial can also be imaged as barren reception: signs remain visible, but the capacity that should receive and grow from them is deprived of its rain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah depicts a counter-sign technology: dispute twists, glitter deceives, falsehood tries to make truth lose its footing, embellished action blocks the path, and followers inherit the supplied orientation. The later passive ص ر ف restates the resulting diversion, so the focus passive can include socially mediated rerouting without erasing personal or divine agency.

activation_trace.role: Directional reversal anchors every contextual operation back in the focus passive.
Visible signs are the genuine orientation against which counter-signs operate.
Twisted contention supplies the discursive operation that wraps around the signs.
A gleaming but unstable deception supplies attractive false visibility.
Loss of footing supplies the attempted displacement of truth by false argument.
Making an act appear beautiful supplies the manufacture of an appealing rival orientation.
Active obstruction and turning away supplies the path-blocking result.
Following behind supplies the social transmission of the imposed route.
Being sent back from a face directly echoes and confirms the focus's passive diversion.

structural_cues: Dispute over God's signs recurs at 40:4, 40:35, 40:56, and 40:69.
40:5 pairs falsehood with an attempt to dislodge truth, while 40:37 pairs beautification with obstruction from the path.
40:69 restates the focus pattern with a passive directional verb immediately after sign-disputation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies twisted dispute, deceptive shine, lost footing, beautification, blockage, following, and later diversion; I infer a social-discursive chain that installs a rival orientation. Personal self-deception and divine judicial turning remain live alternatives rather than being replaced.

changed_reading.before: The turning is a private cognitive error affecting isolated deniers.
changed_reading.after: The turning can be produced through public counter-signs: persuasive distortion dislodges truth, blocks its route, and is socially followed until the deniers themselves are rerouted.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated travel, directed looking, surviving traces, guidance, path, and diversion turn آيات into waymarks in a navigable historical landscape. Denial removes usable orientation: one can move through the terrain and see its traces yet still be turned from the route they indicate.

activation_trace.role: The visible marker anchors the navigational function of signs.
Turning from a proper direction supplies the route failure named in the focus.
Movement through the land supplies the traveler who must orient from encountered evidence.
Directed sight and insight supply the act of reading the route.
A surviving mark that indicates what occurred supplies historical waypoints.
Gentle indication toward the true road supplies active guidance.
An extended traversable path supplies the course that signs and guidance identify.
Diversion from a face supplies the terminal loss of orientation.

structural_cues: The paired command to travel the earth and look at predecessors' outcome occurs at both 40:21 and 40:82.
The believing man's counterclaim at 40:38 explicitly joins guidance to a path.
40:69 places sign-disputation beside a passive question of diversion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies movement, directed looking, residual marks, path, guidance, and diversion; I infer that signs function as route markers across space and history. They may alternatively remain evidentiary signs without a fully spatial mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The signs are abstract propositions that deniers fail to assent to.
changed_reading.after: The signs are also waymarks: denial is a navigational failure in which visible traces no longer orient conduct, so the traveler is turned off the indicated road.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated refusal is accumulated, requited, and stamped. A due consequence, repayment for acquisition, and the imprinting of a heart make the focus passive read as ratification of practiced denial rather than an unexplained deprivation of access.

activation_trace.role: Knowing denial supplies the accountable practice being ratified.
Sustained occurrence through time supplies accumulation rather than a single offense.
A fixed obligation becoming due supplies the consequence that now attaches.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies the response structure.
What is acquired by pursuit supplies the deniers' own contribution to the resulting state.
A seal that fixes an image supplies the finalization of a repeatedly enacted disposition.

structural_cues: كَذَٰلِكَ introduces both the due word at 40:6 and the heart-imprint at 40:35 before the focus refrain at 40:63.
40:17 states recompense by what each self acquired, while the focus places passive turning after habitual denial.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a due consequence, acquired action, matching recompense, and a fixed imprint; I infer a juridical sequence from repeated refusal to ratified orientation. The repeated formulas may instead be analogical refrains without a strict procedural chain.

changed_reading.before: They are arbitrarily turned before or apart from their denial.
changed_reading.after: Their passive turning reads like a verdict-imprint: a repeatedly acquired knowing refusal is fixed into the orientation it has practiced.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah opens hidden interiors to inspection and contrasts inner blindness with insight before ending with a verb of nonrecognition. These cues sharpen ج ح د as managed mismatch: disclosed or inwardly available knowledge is kept from becoming acknowledgment.

activation_trace.role: Denial of what is known anchors the gap between inward recognition and outward refusal.
Visible marks make the object of denial available rather than absent.
Disclosure to a knower supplies epistemic exposure.
Concealment supplies the hidden layer that outward conduct can contradict.
The interior as the source from which acts issue supplies a route from hidden state to public denial.
Blindness of insight supplies a condition deeper than unavailable visual data.
Insight of the heart supplies the live alternative capacity.
The contrary of recognition and admission restates denial as refused acknowledgment.

structural_cues: 40:19 places divine knowledge beside what eyes betray and chests hide.
40:58 formally opposes the blind and the seeing before saying remembrance is rare.
40:81 asks which displayed signs are being disowned.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden interiors, disclosure, heart-blindness, insight, and nonrecognition; I infer continuity from available recognition to controlled refusal. The verses may address different groups, so the sequence need not describe one individual's psychology.

changed_reading.before: The deniers lack the information needed to recognize the signs.
changed_reading.after: The deniers manage an exposed contradiction: signs are available and inward recognition remains possible, but acknowledgment is suppressed until the contradiction itself becomes disorientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet directly co-locates shown signs, provision delivered from the sky, remembering, and returning. That sequence activates the focus's rain-deprived land and scarcity branches: signs are provision offered to a receiving ground, while return reopens reception and habitual denial leaves it barren.

activation_trace.role: Rain diverted from land anchors the image of failed reception.
Scarcity of good, rain, and growth supplies the barren result.
Shown marks tie the material provision sequence back to the focus signs.
Delivery downward supplies provision moving toward a receiver.
Rain descending as provision makes the nourishment mechanism explicit.
Habitual return supplies the receptive countermovement to being turned away.
Soft, growth-bearing earth supplies the fruitful receiver denied by the focus's barren branch.

structural_cues: 40:13 co-locates displayed signs, provision sent from the sky, remembrance, and return.
40:61-64 surround the focus with night and day visibility, unthanked bounty, settled earth, built sky, embodied form, and good provision.
40:79-81 close with animals, riding, eating, benefits, needs, and displayed signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies signs beside descending provision and return, then a provision-rich material surround; I infer a soil-and-rain model of reception. These may instead be adjacent examples of power and generosity rather than one sustained ecological metaphor.

changed_reading.before: Turning away is only movement from an argument.
changed_reading.after: Turning away is also failed nourishment: habitual denial leaves the sign-receiving ground barren, while return would let the descending provision take root.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the focus, repeated كَانُوا constructions attach durable conduct to eventual enclosure: exulting, swaggering, and mocking persist as temporal profiles until what was mocked closes around the actors. The closing appeal to an established course makes the focus's كَانُوا a transhistorical habit-pattern.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence through past time anchors denial as an enacted duration.
Repeated being-in-time binds two ongoing behaviors into a durable profile.
Overweening delight supplies one repeatedly inhabited behavior.
Past persistence connects mockery to the consequence that later surrounds it.
Mockery supplies the repeated stance whose object returns as consequence.
A running, followed course supplies the transhistorical regularity of the pattern.

structural_cues: 40:75 repeats كُنتُمْ for exulting and swaggering.
40:83 says that what they had habitually mocked closed around them.
40:85 names an established course that has already passed among servants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated past-state constructions, persistent behaviors, enveloping consequence, and an established course; I infer habituation as the temporal bridge to passive turning. The forms can also function as ordinary past description without implying psychological hardening.

changed_reading.before: كَانُوا merely locates denial at a past moment.
changed_reading.after: كَانُوا marks a repeatedly inhabited orientation: denial hardens through duration, and يُؤْفَكُ names where that durable practice has brought its practitioners.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it follows material container branches rather than the ordinary abstract sense of denial. It remains anchored in the focus through ج ح د's full-vessel branch beside its knowing-denial branch, and context supplies a throat, closure after fullness, a terminal seal, and bonds at the neck. Downstream prose should present it only as an analogy of suppressed acknowledgment, not as the lexical meaning of يَجْحَدُونَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ج ح د carries both knowing denial and an image of a filled vessel; the focus can therefore be tested as recognition held under pressure rather than absent content.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge inwardly retained supplies the content being prevented from becoming admission.
A filled skin or sack supplies the pressurized container image.
The throat supplies the narrowed outlet between interior state and voiced admission.
Closing an opening after fullness supplies containment under pressure.
Fullness to the limit supplies the terminal saturation of the interior.
A collar constraining an organ externalizes the inward blockage.
The neck locates the later bodily manifestation of constricted acknowledgment.

changed_reading.before: Denial reflects an empty interior with no recognized truth present.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, denial is an overfull but sealed interior: recognized truth is held below the throat until the practiced blockage becomes a fixed and externally manifest constraint.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's form-distant س م و to و س م mapping, where first rain marks earth through vegetation. It remains valid because 40:13 itself joins sky, displayed signs, descending rain-provision, and return, while the focus supplies visible marks and rain-diverted land. Downstream prose should label this a split-root material activation, not claim that السماء ordinarily means inscription.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: آيات as visible marks and ء ف ك as land deprived of rain permit the world itself to be read as a rain-inscribed sign surface.

activation_trace.role: Visible marks anchor the reading in the focus's sign language.
Rain diverted from land supplies the erased or unrealized sign surface.
First rain marking earth through growth supplies material inscription from the sky cue.
Rain as descending provision supplies the medium of that inscription.
Soft growth-bearing earth supplies the surface on which the mark becomes visible.

changed_reading.before: Signs are discrete statements set before an observer.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, signs are rain-written growth across a receptive world; being turned away is failure to read the material inscription and failure to receive what writes it.

strongest_changes: The passive turning becomes an accumulated, verdict-like ratification of knowing denial rather than an unexplained loss of access.
Signs shift from abstract proofs to route markers contested by twisted, attractive, and socially transmitted counter-signs.
The sky-provision sequence activates a material ecology in which denial is barrenness and failed reception.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made directional, juridical, epistemic, and ecological mechanisms coexist. Especially productive was the exact pairing of the focus's drought branches with 40:13's signs, sky-sent provision, remembrance, and return, plus the packet's split sky-to-mark branch.
remaining_uncertainties: The passive agent remains underdetermined: divine judicial turning, self-habituation, and social mediation can coexist.
The ecological, vessel-pressure, and rain-inscription readings are material analogies and should not displace the ordinary directional and epistemic senses.
Contextual sequences may address different groups, so not every mechanism must describe one continuous individual psychology.
